title: 第1608章 获得玄冰金焰第1607章 收坐骑铁领鹰
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
夜色降临时，铁领鹰的速度微微慢了下来，像是经过大半个白天的飞行已经消耗了不少体力。
他拍了一下铁领鹰的背部：“下去休息。”
铁领鹰发出一声低沉的鸣叫，缓缓降低高度，落在一座低矮的山丘上。
李天从铁领鹰背上跃下，铁领鹰收起翅膀，在他不远处蹲下，像一只被驯服的大鸟。
另一只也落了下来，在它身旁蹲下。
李天靠着山丘的背风面坐下，闭目调息。
夜色中隐约传来风声和远处铁领鹰偶尔抖落羽毛的声音。
一夜无事，翌日清晨，天光未亮，他睁开眼睛，站起身，看了一眼那两只铁领鹰，没有多说，纵身跃上那只较大的铁领鹰背部。
铁领鹰振翅而起，另一只紧随其后，朝着西北方向继续飞去。
晨光从东面漫上来，照亮了前方那道正在逐渐逼近的深灰色线条。
他在铁领鹰背上坐直了身体，目光落在那道正在变粗的线条上，没有让铁领鹰减速。
铁领鹰持续飞了约莫半个时辰后，前方的地貌忽然发生了变化——灰黑色的山脉之间出现了一片开阔的谷地，谷地中央有神力波动传来。
他放慢了速度，铁领鹰的飞行姿态也微微调整了一下，像是感应到了什么。
他没有让它绕开，让它保持着缓慢的速度从谷地边缘掠过。
谷地中央站着一群人，围着一块凸起的岩石，岩石上方悬浮着一团金色的光芒，如同火焰一般缓慢跳动。
那团光芒表面泛着暗沉的纹理，散发出的热量却让周围的空间微微扭曲，像是什么东西正在那片区域的核心处缓慢地成形。
他认出了其中几道身影——为首的是个身形魁梧的僧人，穿着暗红色袈裟，脖颈上挂着一串粗大佛珠——桑吉。
他正站在金色光芒前方数丈处，双手结印，试图破解那层保护火焰的屏障。
他身后站着七八名同样装束的僧人，各自散开。
李天没有让铁领鹰停下，但他认出了那团火焰——金色为表，寒冰为核，玄冰金焰。

他体内的紫薇天火微微跳动了一下，像是对同源之物产生了感应，然后恢复平静。
他拍了拍铁领鹰的背部，铁领鹰发出一声低沉的鸣叫，收拢翅膀，朝谷地一侧落了下去。
铁领鹰落在谷地边缘一块凸起的岩石上，收起翅膀蹲下，另一只也跟着落在一旁，两双赤红的眼睛望着谷地中央的方向。
李天从鹰背上跃下，没有隐藏身形，也没有刻意放缓脚步，沿着谷地边缘的石坡向下走去。
谷地中央的僧人感应到了他的靠近，有人转过身来，目光落在他身上，随即低声说了句什么。
桑吉也停下了手中的印诀，转头看向来人的方向，目光中先是疑惑，随即变成了一种带着戒备的打量。
“是你？”
桑吉的声音不高不低，像是认出了他，“当初在灵山脚下，我记得你。”
李天在距离他们十余丈处停下，目光扫过那团悬浮在岩石上方的金色火焰：“那团火，我要了。”
桑吉的面色沉了一下，李天的威名他不是一次两次听说，现在出现在这里，怕是自己保不住这团玄冰金焰了。
content_en:
As night fell, the Iron-collared Eagle slowed down slightly, as if it had consumed a lot of energy after flying for most of the day.
He patted the Iron-collared Eagle on the back and said, "Go down and rest."
The Iron-collared Eagle let out a low cry, slowly lowered its height, and landed on a low hill.
Li Tian jumped off the back of the iron-collared eagle. The iron-collared eagle folded its wings and squatted not far from him, like a tamed big bird.
The other one also fell down and squatted down beside it.
Li Tian sat down against the leeward side of the hill, closed his eyes and adjusted his breath.
There was a faint sound of wind in the night and the occasional sound of distant ruffed eagles fluttering their feathers.
Nothing happened all night. The next morning, before dawn, he opened his eyes, stood up, glanced at the two fern-collared eagles, and without saying anything, jumped on the back of the larger feral-collared eagle.
The iron-collared eagle flapped its wings, and the other followed closely behind, continuing to fly toward the northwest.
The morning light came up from the east, illuminating the dark gray line that was gradually approaching in front.
He sat upright on the back of the Iron-collared Eagle, his eyes fell on the thickening line, and did not let the Iron-collared Eagle slow down.
After the Iron-collared Eagle continued flying for about half an hour, the landscape ahead suddenly changed - an open valley appeared between the gray-black mountains, and there was a fluctuation of divine power in the center of the valley.
He slowed down, and the Iron-collared Eagle's flying posture also slightly adjusted, as if it sensed something.
He did not let it go around, letting it pass by the edge of the valley at a slow speed.
A group of people stood in the center of the valley, surrounding a raised rock. A ball of golden light was suspended above the rock, beating slowly like a flame.
The surface of that ball of light had a dark texture, but the heat it emitted made the surrounding space slightly distorted, as if something was slowly taking shape at the core of that area.
He recognized several figures among them - the leader was a burly monk, wearing a dark red cassock, with a string of thick Buddhist beads hanging around his neck - Sanchi.
He was standing a few feet in front of the golden light, forming seals with his hands, trying to break through the barrier protecting the flames.
Behind him stood seven or eight monks in the same attire, spreading out.
Li Tian did not let the Iron-collared Eagle stop, but he recognized the flame - gold as the surface, ice as the core, and black ice and golden flames.
The crape myrtle sky fire in his body beat slightly, as if it was sensing something of the same origin, and then returned to calm.
He patted the Iron-collared Eagle on its back, and the Iron-collared Eagle let out a low cry, folded its wings, and landed toward the side of the valley.
The iron-collared eagle landed on a raised rock on the edge of the valley, folded its wings and squatted down, and the other one also landed beside it, looking towards the center of the valley with its two pairs of red eyes.
Li Tian jumped off the eagle's back, without hiding his figure or deliberately slowing down, and walked down the stone slope at the edge of the valley.
The monk in the middle of the valley sensed his approach. Someone turned around, looked at him, and then whispered something.
Sanji also stopped the seal in his hand and turned to look in the direction of the person. His eyes were filled with confusion at first, and then turned into a cautious look.
"Is it you?"
Sanji's voice was neither high nor low, as if he recognized him, "I remember you when we were at the foot of Lingshan Mountain."
Li Tian stopped more than ten feet away from them and glanced at the golden flame suspended above the rock: "I want that fire."
Sanji's expression darkened. He had heard of Li Tian's fame not once or twice. Now that he appeared here, he was afraid that he would not be able to protect this ball of black ice and golden flames.
